why: Case 3 of the four this directory exists for: SyncPullService attaches four computed SLA fields to every `tickets` row, the mirror schema had no columns for them, and `upsert_row` dropped them SILENTLY - it skips any key the local table lacks. Both suites stayed green. The fixture names the keys the server really sends so the mirror schema and the mapper are both held to them.
completeness_note: The `row` below is a SUBSET of the real pull row, not the whole of it. Consumers therefore assert containment, never equality: the backend proves every key here appears in what SyncPullService produced, and the crate proves every non-envelope key here has a mirror column. Widening this to the full row is listed as remaining work - see the crate test's module doc.
envelope_note: `upsert_row` handles these three itself - `id` becomes `server_id`, `client_id` is the primary key, `sync_version` becomes `server_sync_version` - so they are the three keys that must NOT be looked for as columns of the same name.

mapped.note: What `mappers.ts::mapTicket` must read off the row above. `sla_remaining_seconds: null` and `0` are different answers (KARAR A23) and neither may collapse into the other - mappers.test.ts holds the null/zero pair; this fixture holds the field names.
